name: QuickTapSurvey
description_en:
QuickTapSurvey is a mobile survey and form service built around collecting information in person. A team designs a questionnaire, puts it on phones or tablets, and collects responses through an interviewer or a kiosk. Its defining capability is offline capture: the mobile app keeps data on the device until it reconnects. This makes the product relevant to trade-show lead capture, field research and on-site feedback where a reliable connection cannot be assumed.

The operational unit is the collection device, not simply the number of people creating surveys. Pricing requires a license for each phone or tablet and warns that responses collected without a device license cannot be accessed until one is purchased. QuickTapSurvey is presented on a Formstack-branded site; this profile describes its own mobile workflow rather than assigning it every capability of the broader Formstack suite.
description_zh:
QuickTapSurvey 是围绕现场采集设计的移动问卷与表单服务。团队先设计问卷，再把它放到手机或平板上，通过访问员或自助终端收集回答。其关键能力是离线采集：设备重新联网前，移动应用会把数据保留在本机。适合展会线索收集、实地调研和现场反馈等不能假设网络始终可靠的工作。

运营成本的基本单位是采集设备，而不只是创建问卷的人数。每台手机或平板需要设备许可；定价说明特别提醒，无许可设备虽然能采集回答，但购买许可前不能访问这些回答。官网页脚归属 Formstack，本文仅描述 QuickTapSurvey 自己的移动流程，不把 Formstack 全部产品能力并入本档案。

core_features.explanation_en: Responses stay in the mobile app until the device reconnects.
core_features.explanation_zh: 设备重新联网前，回答保留在移动应用内。

core_features.explanation_en: Choose subsequent questions according to selected answers.
core_features.explanation_zh: 根据已选答案决定后续显示哪些问题。

core_features.explanation_en: Remote survey distribution and role-based user permissions support a collection team.
core_features.explanation_zh: 通过远程下发问卷和按角色分配权限来管理采集团队。

en: Collect leads at an exhibition without depending on venue Wi-Fi.
Run an attended interview or unattended feedback kiosk.
zh: 在展会采集线索，不依赖场馆 Wi-Fi。
开展访问员面访或无人值守反馈采集。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Build a short survey and define its branching and branding.
steps.zh: 创建简短问卷，设置分支和品牌样式。

steps.en: Install the relevant mobile app and allocate a device license before fieldwork.
steps.zh: 安装对应移动应用，在外出采集前分配设备许可。

steps.en: Check one offline response after reconnection and verify access and export before rolling out to other devices.
steps.zh: 先核对一条离线回答在联网后的可访问性与导出结果，再推广到其他设备。

items.en: Offline collection does not mean the central team can see unsynchronized device data immediately.
items.zh: 能够离线采集不表示中心团队可以立即看到尚未同步的设备数据。

items.en: The free trial is fourteen days, ten responses and one device; it is not a sustained free plan.
items.zh: 免费试用限 14 天、10 条回答和 1 台设备，不是持续免费套餐。

pricing.billing_basis: Subscription plan plus the number of licensed collection devices; monthly or annual billing.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Pro and Premium are billed by plan and device count. The page shows annual equivalents around $41 and $84 per month, but also annual totals of $499.80 and $1009.80; these displays do not reconcile exactly, so no normalized price is asserted. Extra device rates differ by plan and billing period; 25+ devices require an enterprise discussion. Trial: fourteen days, ten responses, one device, no credit card.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Pro 和 Premium 按套餐与设备数计费。页面显示年付折合月价约 $41 和 $84，同时又列出 $499.80 和 $1009.80 的年度总额；两种展示不能精确对应，因此本文不填标准化月价。额外设备费随套餐与账期变化，25 台以上需洽谈企业报价。试用为 14 天、10 条回答、1 台设备，无需信用卡。

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Design for a device that may lose connectivity
sections.title_zh: 按可能断网的设备设计采集
sections.en:
Create the survey centrally and distribute it to the mobile devices doing the work. QuickTapSurvey supports iOS and Android phones and tablets, as well as interviewer-led and kiosk collection. Its feature page explicitly says offline data remains in the app until reconnection. That separates local capture from data being available to a remote analyst.

For an illustrative exhibition workflow, prepare a lead form with contact details and an interest question, install it before the event, and verify a response after a deliberate offline interval. Check the synchronized record, rather than treating the tablet's completion screen as proof that sales staff can already use the lead. This is a proposed acceptance exercise, not a test we performed.
sections.zh:
先集中创建问卷，再下发到实际采集的移动设备。QuickTapSurvey 支持 iOS、Android 手机和平板，也支持访问员采集及自助终端。功能页明确说明，离线数据在重新联网前留在应用中，因此本地完成采集与远程分析员能够看到数据是两个时点。

例如，展会线索表可以包含联系方式和一个意向问题，活动前安装好，并安排一次断网后重新联网的回答核对。应检查同步后的真实记录，不能仅凭平板的完成页面就认为销售已经能使用该线索。这是建议的验收方式，本文没有实际执行。

sections.title_en: Use branching to keep the field interaction relevant
sections.title_zh: 用分支保持现场问答相关
sections.en:
The survey builder offers answer-dependent question selection, branding and templates. A visitor who declines follow-up could skip optional sales questions, while someone requesting contact could see the relevant fields. The site also describes language content based on UTF-8 support; this is a questionnaire-content capability, not evidence that the administrator interface is localized into every language.

Our recommendation is to inspect both branches on the actual collection device. Small touchscreens, optional fields and the return to the next respondent matter more to an unattended kiosk than a polished desktop preview.
sections.zh:
编辑器提供基于答案的问题选择、品牌样式和模板。拒绝后续联系的访客可以跳过可选销售问题，希望获得联系的人则进入相关字段。官网还说明问卷内容支持 UTF-8 字符，这表示问卷内容的语言能力，不证明管理界面支持所有语言。

建议在实际采集设备上检查两条分支。对无人值守终端而言，小屏触控、可选字段和如何进入下一位受访者，比桌面预览是否美观更影响可用性。

sections.title_en: Count collection devices before estimating cost
sections.title_zh: 先数采集设备，再估算费用
sections.en:
QuickTapSurvey's pricing FAQ defines one device license as authorization for one mobile phone or tablet. It also makes an important access distinction: an unlicensed device may collect responses, but those responses cannot be accessed until a license is bought. Unlimited users and responses in paid-plan descriptions therefore do not imply unlimited licensed hardware.

A hypothetical booth using four tablets should request a four-device quote for the intended plan and billing period. Do not multiply the displayed one-device headline without checking the additional-device rate. Enterprise pricing is offered for deployments using more than 25 devices.
sections.zh:
定价 FAQ 将一份设备许可定义为授权一台手机或平板，并特别区分采集和访问：未获许可的设备可以采集回答，但购买许可前不能访问回答。因此，付费套餐说明中的不限用户和回答，不代表设备数量也不限。

假设展台使用四台平板，应按所选套餐和账期取得四台设备的报价。不能只把单设备标题价格乘以四，还需要核对增购设备费。使用超过 25 台设备时，官网提供企业报价。

sections.title_en: Separate trial limits from paid subscriptions
sections.title_zh: 区分试用限制与付费订阅
sections.en:
The free trial includes all features but lasts fourteen days and allows only ten responses on one device. It is useful for checking a short capture-and-sync path; a full event requires a paid capacity decision. The site accepts monthly or annual subscriptions and says users can upgrade, downgrade or cancel.

The extracted pricing view mixes rounded monthly headlines with annual totals that do not divide to exactly those headlines. We preserve that uncertainty instead of publishing a precise derived monthly amount. Confirm the selected plan, currency, total annual charge and extra devices at checkout. This profile does not establish any refund or prorating entitlement.
sections.zh:
免费试用包含全部功能，但只有 14 天、1 台设备和 10 条回答。适合核对一条简短的采集与同步流程，完整活动仍需决定付费容量。官网支持月付或年付，并说明可以升级、降级或取消。\n
本次读取的价格视图同时展示取整月价与无法精确对应的年度总额。本文保留这一不确定性，不公布推算出的精确月价。购买时需确认所选套餐、币种、年度总支出及额外设备费。本文未确认退款或按比例退费权利。

sections.title_en: Plan the response handoff and product boundary
sections.title_zh: 规划回答交接与产品边界
sections.en:
The feature page lists reporting, data exports and connections with services such as Zapier, Mailchimp and Salesforce. These are routes for using captured information after collection; the homepage list does not establish every supported field, authentication method or delivery guarantee. Ask for the exact connector behavior required by your destination.

QuickTapSurvey is a reasonable shortlist for a managed mobile collection fleet. A project that only needs a simple web link, or requires a verified self-hosted server, should investigate those requirements separately. No self-hosting or source-code license was established in the pages read. The linked help center returned only a shell during this research, so recovery after a damaged device or failed synchronization remains a specific gap.
sections.zh:
功能页列有报表、数据导出，以及 Zapier、Mailchimp、Salesforce 等连接方式。这些用于采集后的数据交接，但首页名称列表不能证明每个字段、认证方式或送达保证均受支持。应核对目标系统需要的具体连接行为。

对于需要管理一批移动采集设备的任务，QuickTapSurvey 值得列入候选；仅需一个网页链接，或要求已验证自托管服务的项目，应另外核查相应条件。本次读取未确认自托管或源码许可。官方链接的帮助中心仅返回空壳页面，因此设备损坏及同步失败后的恢复流程仍是明确缺口。

research_gaps: No hands-on mobile installation, offline synchronization, kiosk reset or export was tested.
Exact checkout amounts and additional-device billing require confirmation because extracted annual totals and monthly headlines differ.
The official help center returned a shell; damaged-device recovery and failed-sync handling were not verified.
Self-hosting, source license, contractual storage region, current OS requirements and administrator UI languages remain unverified.
